request: Add third rotor blade to the assembly. It should have the same design as the other two. Radii should applied on all four long edges of the blade. Adjust central portion of all three blades so that there is a space for a new blade - reduce thickness of the central portion to cca 0,42mm. New blade should go through the center of the stack.

actions.operation: Create and add a third rotor blade by reproducing the design of the existing rotor blades.
actions.target: The rotor-blade assembly and the new third rotor blade.
actions.relational_constraint: The third blade must have the same design as the other two blades.
actions.unresolved_reference: Identify the assembly, the two existing rotor blades, and the existing blade geometry or feature definition to use as the source design.

actions.operation: Apply radii or fillets to the blade edges.
actions.target: All four long edges of the referenced blade.
actions.relational_constraint: The radii must be applied to all four edges identified as the blade's long edges.
actions.unresolved_reference: Identify which blade is meant by 'the blade,' resolve its four long edges, and obtain the required radius value.

actions.operation: Reduce the thickness of the central portions of the blades.
actions.target: The central portion of each of all three blades.
actions.relational_constraint: All three blade central portions must be adjusted to approximately the stated final thickness to provide space for the new blade.
actions.unresolved_reference: Identify the boundaries of the central portion on each blade and determine the direction or faces from which thickness is to be reduced.

actions.operation: Position the new blade in the assembly.
actions.relational_constraint: The new blade must pass through the center of the stack.
actions.unresolved_reference: Identify the stack and its center, and determine the blade orientation and placement required to pass through that center.

intention: Provide sufficient space in the central stack to accommodate a third rotor blade.
Integrate the new blade through the center of the existing blade stack.
